attributes.proposal_description:
Our proposal is to build wallets embedded with the Bondex profiles: https://bondex.app/p/Ignacio The wallet will be multichain to enable the Bondex ID and Reputation score to be a log in option across DAPPs, DEXs, CEXs and Ecosystems

**Core Features & Value:**
- Key abstraction
- Multichain
- Seamless integration into the Bondex App - Users mint their wallet when they generate their Profile
- The Bondex ID and Score mints across chains 
- Log in capability
- Smart Contract & Escrow system to enable payments from GIG and other fractional economic opportunities in our marketplace
- Collect Badges, Attestations, POAPs, NFTS and other form of loyalty program mechanisms from DAPPS through engagement
- Users will be able to log in DAPPs throughout ecosystems and collect rewards 
- DAPPs will be able to develop superior loyalty programs, incentive systems and superior targeting by unlocking valuable user data not available today in Web 3
- Users will have the ability to monetize their networks, time and skills while building their reputation in their interoperable ID / Passport

Bondex is the largest Web3 professional network with 4.9M+ downloads and major enterprise adoption from top Web3 companies. Our learnings over the last three years of building and battle testing our products have given us invaluable insights that led us to evolve our vision beyond a Web3 LinkedIn killer into a new generation of Social Network, based on Trust through Reputation, a signal through the noise to navigate Web3 and beyond.

Bondex is in the unique position to leverage its existing platform which combines professional networking and our AI-powered Job Portal with decentralized community referrals to launch this Next Gen Social Economic Network (SEN). The development pipeline for January 2025 includes enhanced features such as on-chain credentials, Web 2.5 Profiles and the Bondex Reputation Score. These features represent the foundational infrastructure of trust upon which our future social features and the expansion of economic opportunities on the platform will enable the peer-to-peer exchange of networks, money, time and skills.

This proposal seeks to integrate Bondex with the Cardano ecosystem, bringing its professional network, verifiable credentials, and reputation system to Cardano users and projects.

**Current Platform:**
- Professional Networking Mobile App  
  - 4.9M+ downloads  
  - 2M completed profiles  
  - 4.7m connected wallets  
  - Gamified engagement with Bond Points rewards
- Job Portal  
  - AI-powered job matching & Career coach  
  - Real world use by major Web3 companies  
  - Decentralized recruitment through community referrals  
  - Built-in freelance recruiter network  
  - Cross-border payments and rewards distribution  
  - Strong enterprise adoption with >$300k available in talent bounties and 45 companies using the beta platform since release

**Major Releases Dec 2024/Jan 2025:**
- **Bondex Reputation Score**  
  - Verified credentials across proof of humanity, work, and skills  
  - Aggregates and verifies reputation from Web2 platforms users use (LinkedIn, Twitter, Github)  
  - On-chain reputation from ENS and Wallets
- **Web 2.5 Profiles**  
  - Modular: Everyone is unique, displaying skills, experience, and interests is bespoke on Bondex  
  - Verify and aggregate reputation from Web2 and Web3 platforms to build Reputation score  
  - Send the link to unique public profile to everyone, a personalized home page  
  - Mint profile as a passport, interoperable with more DApps and Ecosystems (WorldCoin, Jambo and SuperTeam)
- **Bondex Business Digital Card**  
  - Business Card on Apple/Google Wallet - One tap to share Telegram QR code  
  - Natively built into Telegram for Web3 networkers  
  - Exchange Business Card in chat with bio connected to Bondex Profile  
  - Mini CRM for contact management

The Bondex ecosystem employs a dual hybrid token model, leveraging an off-chain premium currency (Bond points) with an on-chain token ($BDXN). This creates a meritocratic token economy in which platform adoption and utility drive token value appreciation through systematic buybacks, value distribution, and a focus on token velocity throughout the internal economy.
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
1) **Integration of Bondex's Social Economic Network (SEN) with Cardano's blockchain infrastructure** - Bondex ID with on-chain attestations compatible with the Cardano ecosystem for the Bondex ID to be mintable on Cardano

2) **Requirement Analysis and Planning**

**Deliverables:**
- Detailed documentation outlining the scope, features, and technical requirements of the SDK.
- Project roadmap with timelines and milestones.

**Definition of Done:**
- Stakeholder approval of the requirements document.
- Established project plan with assigned resources and deadlines.

3) **User Authentication Module**

**Deliverables:**
- Implementation of various authentication methods, including email, phone, and social logins (e.g., Google, Apple).

**Definition of Done:**
- Users can successfully register and log in using multiple authentication methods.
- Authentication flows are secure and comply with industry standards.

4) **Embedded Wallet Infrastructure**

**Deliverables:**
- Development of non-custodial embedded wallets utilizing Threshold Signature Scheme-Multi-Party Computation (TSS-MPC) for key management.

**Definition of Done:**
- Users can create and manage wallets directly within the application.
- Wallets support key recovery options and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

5) **Multi-Chain Adapter**

**Deliverables:**
- Integration with multiple blockchain networks (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin) to support over 500 external wallets.

**Definition of Done:**
- Users can connect and interact with various blockchain networks seamlessly.
- Successful execution of transactions across supported chains.

6) **Global Wallet Kit**

**Deliverables:**
- Development of a system that allows users to utilize a single wallet across multiple applications, enhancing interoperability.

**Definition of Done:**
- Users can access and interact with different applications using a unified wallet.
- Consistent user experience across various platforms.

7) **Security and Fraud Protection**

**Deliverables:**
- Implementation of security measures, including encryption, fraud detection, and compliance controls such as screening against sanctions lists.

**Definition of Done:**
- The application passes security audits and penetration testing.
- Real-time detection and mitigation of fraudulent activities.

8) **User Interface (UI) Components**

**Deliverables:**
- Design and development of customizable UI components for wallet interactions, ensuring a seamless user experience.

**Definition of Done:**
- UI components are responsive, accessible, and align with the overall design guidelines.
- Positive user feedback from usability testing.

9) **Developer SDK and Documentation**

**Deliverables:**
- Creation of a developer-friendly SDK with comprehensive documentation, including code examples and integration guides.

**Definition of Done:**
- External developers can integrate the SDK into their applications with minimal support.
- Documentation is complete, accurate, and regularly updated.

10) **Testing and Quality Assurance**

**Deliverables:**
- Comprehensive test plans covering unit, integration, and system testing.
- Automated test suites to ensure code quality and reliability.

**Definition of Done:**
- All tests pass successfully with high code coverage.
- No critical bugs remain unresolved.

11) **Deployment and Maintenance**

**Deliverables:**
- Deployment of the SDK to production environments.
- Establishment of monitoring and support systems for ongoing maintenance.

**Definition of Done:**
- The SDK is live and accessible to users.
- Monitoring tools are in place to track performance and user engagement.
### 1. **Wallet Adoption**
- **We deliver** a multichain, non-custodial wallet system **reaching** 150,000+ created Bondex wallets within 12 months.


> “This outcome demonstrates adoption of Bondex’s identity wallet infrastructure at scale, justifying the investment with significant user onboarding.”


---


### 2. **Active Usage**
- **We deliver** a seamless, embedded wallet experience across Web3 profiles **reaching** 30,000+ monthly active wallets (MAWs) by Month 9.


> “This outcome proves retention and real engagement — validating that users find long-term value in the Bondex wallet layer.”


---


### 3. **Reputation Engine**
- **We deliver** a real-time on-chain reputation system **reaching** 1,000,000 dynamic scores issued across chains.


> “This outcome reflects Bondex’s impact as a trust layer — a vital primitive for opportunity, discovery, and rewards in Web3.”


---


### 4. **Cardano Identity Integration**
- **We deliver** a verifiable credential module compatible with Cardano DID infrastructure **reaching** 250,000 on-chain credentials minted on Cardano.


> “This outcome shows strong alignment with Cardano’s roadmap and enhances the utility of its identity ecosystem.”


---


### 5. **dApp & Protocol Adoption**
- **We deliver** an SDK for developers to build with Bondex ID and wallets **reaching** 5+ Cardano dApps integrated by Month 12.


> “This outcome confirms ecosystem-level utility, turning Bondex into a shared service layer across Cardano.”


---


### 6. **Work & Opportunity Matching**
- **We deliver** identity-based matching and payment infrastructure for jobs and gigs **reaching** 10,000 opportunities matched via Bondex wallets.


> “This outcome proves real-world impact — the wallet enables value capture and earning for users, delivering measurable economic opportunity.”


---


### 7. **Sybil Resistance & Trust**
- **We deliver** verified on-chain identity and wallet behavior scoring **reaching** 75%+ of the user base classified as sybil-resistant.


> “This outcome demonstrates integrity in user activity, a foundational requirement for high-trust systems and funding ecosystems.”


---


### 8. **Cross-Chain Onboarding**
- **We deliver** social wallet profiles that connect with EVM, Solana, and Cardano chains **reaching** 100,000 external wallets connected.


> “This outcome proves Bondex’s role as a true multichain identity bridge — lowering barriers and bringing new users into Cardano.”

attributes.problem_statement:
Traditional professional networking platforms have centralized control of user data, lack proper verification systems for professional credentials, and don't incentivize valuable community contributions. Web3 needs a trust-based professional network where reputation becomes a reliable currency for meaningful interactions.

Current talent platforms operate as data monopolies where users are the product without participating in the economic equation. This creates three key problems:

**For Talent/Users:** In today's talent platforms like any Web2 social network, the users are given what they think is a free product when in reality their data and networks are the product without them partaking in the economic equation. The lack of incentives these data monopolies provide leads to these platforms having no stickiness once the talent has secured a job, resulting in very low engagement and rapidly decaying data.

**For Employers:** Human capital is an asset class not a market, it's the most crucial ingredient for any company in any industry at any stage. Yet even though companies spend hundreds of billions per year on recruitment relying on intermediaries who extract too much for the value they provide, 85% of talent acquisition happens via direct networking and referrals.

**For Recruiters/Introducers:** They play a crucial role in the exchange of talent but much like the talent in this market they give most of the value away to the agencies and platforms they work for, in some cases retaining as little as 10% of the revenue they generate.

At Bondex, we have built the first social economic network underpinned by our on-chain reputation score and Web 2.5 profiles. Users can build their profiles while aggregating and verifying their humanity, professional skills, Web 3 credentials, and Web 2 Socials.

Our proposal today is to build multi-chain, flexible, non-custodial embedded wallets that users mint with their profiles. Abstract the complexity of crypto away from users and onboard them with the familiar UX we have already built at Bondex. This will enable the Bondex Profile to become a log in method into DAPPs. Additionally given our existing talent marketplace, we want to add escrow and smart contract services that enable fractional work, helping us expand into the freelance economy.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
**Cardano Users:** Bondex will serve as an interoperable online identity/passport that will enable them to unlock economic opportunities based on their reputation and capture rewards from the DAPPs and Apps they interact with the most in Cardano ecosystem and beyond

**Cardano Ecosystem:** The gap between Web 2 and Web 3 regarding user data presents a significant weakness as we build this next iteration of the internet. We believe there is room for public profiles in web 3, ones in which users choose what data to verify and are empowered to choose if and how it is monetized. Bondex profiles will serve a login method across the Cardano ecosystem, enabling enable its players to get to know their users better, people are more than wallets. This will allow them to create better incentives and loyalty programs through superior targeting and user quality metrics

***We aim to boost transaction activity on Cardano from our Wallet Fee revenue, with the belief that this will help enrich the ecosystem’s treasury. As our treasury-supported initiative reaches profitability from the initial Wallet MVP all the way to evolving to a full-fledged Neobank, we will honor that support by contributing a portion of our revenue back to the Cardano treasury

attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:
1) Integration of Bondex's Social Economic Network (SEN) with Cardano's blockchain infrastructure - Bondex ID with on-chain attestations compatible with the Cardano ecosystem for the Bondex ID to be mintable on Cardano

2) Requirement Analysis and Planning

Deliverables:

Detailed documentation outlining the scope, features, and technical requirements of the SDK.

Project roadmap with timelines and milestones.

Definition of Done:

Stakeholder approval of the requirements document.

Established project plan with assigned resources and deadlines.

3) User Authentication Module

Deliverables:

Implementation of various authentication methods, including email, phone, and social logins (e.g., Google, Apple).

Definition of Done:

Users can successfully register and log in using multiple authentication methods.

Authentication flows are secure and comply with industry standards.

4) Embedded Wallet Infrastructure

Deliverables:

Development of non-custodial embedded wallets utilizing Threshold Signature Scheme-Multi-Party Computation (TSS-MPC) for key management.

Definition of Done:

Users can create and manage wallets directly within the application.

Wallets support key recovery options and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

5) Multi-Chain Adapter

Deliverables:

Integration with multiple blockchain networks (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin) to support over 500 external wallets.

Definition of Done:

Users can connect and interact with various blockchain networks seamlessly.

Successful execution of transactions across supported chains.

6) Global Wallet Kit

Deliverables:

Development of a system that allows users to utilize a single wallet across multiple applications, enhancing interoperability.

Definition of Done:

Users can access and interact with different applications using a unified wallet.

Consistent user experience across various platforms.

7) Security and Fraud Protection

Deliverables:

Implementation of security measures, including encryption, fraud detection, and compliance controls such as screening against sanctions lists.

Definition of Done:

The application passes security audits and penetration testing.

Real-time detection and mitigation of fraudulent activities.

8) User Interface (UI) Components

Deliverables:

Design and development of customizable UI components for wallet interactions, ensuring a seamless user experience.

Definition of Done:

UI components are responsive, accessible, and align with the overall design guidelines.

Positive user feedback from usability testing.

9) Developer SDK and Documentation

Deliverables:

Creation of a developer-friendly SDK with comprehensive documentation, including code examples and integration guides.

Definition of Done:

External developers can integrate the SDK into their applications with minimal support.

Documentation is complete, accurate, and regularly updated.

10) Testing and Quality Assurance

Deliverables:

Comprehensive test plans covering unit, integration, and system testing.

Automated test suites to ensure code quality and reliability.

Definition of Done:

All tests pass successfully with high code coverage.

No critical bugs remain unresolved.

11) Deployment and Maintenance

Deliverables:

Deployment of the SDK to production environments.

Establishment of monitoring and support systems for ongoing maintenance.

Definition of Done:

The SDK is live and accessible to users.

Monitoring tools are in place to track performance and user engagement.

attributes.problem_statement:
Traditional professional networking platforms have centralized control of user data, lack proper verification systems for professional credentials, and don't incentivize valuable community contributions. Web3 needs a trust-based professional network where reputation becomes a reliable currency for meaningful interactions.

Current talent platforms operate as data monopolies where users are the product without participating in the economic equation. This creates three key problems:

For Talent/Users: In today's talent platforms like any Web2 social network, the users are given what they think is a free product when in reality their data and networks are the product without them partaking in the economic equation. The lack of incentives these data monopolies provide leads to these platforms having no stickiness once the talent has secured a job, resulting in very low engagement and rapidly decaying data.

For Employers: Human capital is an asset class not a market, it's the most crucial ingredient for any company in any industry at any stage. Yet even though companies spend hundreds of billions per year on recruitment relying on intermediaries who extract too much for the value they provide, 85% of talent acquisition happens via direct networking and referrals.

For Recruiters/Introducers: They play a crucial role in the exchange of talent but much like the talent in this market they give most of the value away to the agencies and platforms they work for, in some cases retaining as little as 10% of the revenue they generate.

At Bondex, we have built the first social economic network underpinned by our on-chain reputation score and Web 2.5 profiles. Users can build their profiles while aggregating and verifying their humanity, professional skills, Web 3 credentials, and Web 2 Socials.

Our proposal today is to build multi-chain, flexible, non-custodial embedded wallets that users mint with their profiles. Abstract the complexity of crypto away from users and onboard them with the familiar UX we have already built at Bondex. This will enable the Bondex Profile to become a log in method into DAPPs. Additionally given our existing talent marketplace, we want to add escrow and smart contract services that enable fractional work, helping us expand into the freelance economy.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
Cardano Users: Bondex will serve as an interoperable online identity/passport that will enable them to unlock economic opportunities based on their reputation and capture rewards from the DAPPs and Apps they interact with the most in Cardano ecosystem and beyond

Cardano Ecosystem: The gap between Web 2 and Web 3 regarding user data presents a significant weakness as we build this next iteration of the internet. We believe there is room for public profiles in web 3, ones in which users choose what data to verify and are empowered to choose if and how it is monetized. Bondex profiles will serve a login method across the Cardano ecosystem, enabling enable its players to get to know their users better, people are more than wallets. This will allow them to create better incentives and loyalty programs through superior targeting and user quality metrics
attributes.explain_proposal_roadmap: This proposal and grant would enable us to accelerate our existing roadmap, the wallet and freelance payment rails are already part of our long term product roadmap

1. Does it explicitly explain why a blockchain solution is required and why specifically Cardano?

Yes. Bondex is building a decentralized identity layer where trust, reputation, and ownership are verifiable and composable across networks. Blockchain is essential to ensure:
Tamper-proof credentials (skills, activity, personhood)


On-chain reputation and value accrual for users


Ownership of identity and economic outcomes


Cardano is a strategic choice due to:
Its robust identity primitives (e.g. Atala PRISM)


Commitment to scalability, sustainability, and decentralization


The opportunity to expand Cardano’s social and professional use cases — a domain largely untouched in the ecosystem


Bondex brings real-world utility to Cardano’s DID layer, providing a meaningful application beyond speculation or DeFi.


2. Has the project considered how to handle growth, large transaction volumes, or high concurrency?

Yes. The architecture is built with scalability in mind:
The wallet infrastructure leverages TSS-MPC, ensuring performance without sacrificing security


Multi-chain adapters abstract complexity and load balancing across chains


On-chain operations will leverage batching, indexing layers, and Cardano’s native scalability features (e.g., Leios, Hydra) to support high-throughput without congestion


Additionally, Bondex’s current user base (>500K users) provides both experience and infrastructure patterns for supporting growth and concurrency.


3. Does it discuss potential to expand TVL, transactions, or staking incentives on Cardano?

Yes. The wallet and reputation system are designed to:
Drive new wallet creation and on-chain interactions


Unlock staking and delegation flows tied to reputation (e.g., staking boosts, trusted delegation pools)


Enable gig and bounty payments that are escrowed and executed on-chain


Expand NFTs and attestations as loyalty or achievement proofs, all minted on Cardano


These activities can directly influence TVL, staking participation, and transaction volume — especially as more dApps and DAOs integrate Bondex identity and wallet layers.


4. Will it integrate or collaborate with existing Cardano projects, enhancing synergy?

Yes. Bondex intends to:
Integrate with Atala PRISM to align with Cardano's identity standards


Offer Bondex Wallet SDK and Reputation Graph to Cardano dApps, DAOs, and protocols


Collaborate with DAO tooling, DeFi platforms, and hiring/education initiatives to support identity-driven use ca
